fund_share.label: Share of race fundraising
fund_share.desc: Candidate's share of ALL money raised in the race - donors are forecasters with skin in the game.

fund_indiv_pct.label: Individual-donor share of funds
fund_indiv_pct.desc: Share of the candidate's money from individual donors.

fund_pac_rel.label: PAC share vs party norm
fund_pac_rel.desc: Share of the candidate's money from PACs, minus the median for their party that cycle (Democrats largely stopped taking corporate PAC money after 2018).

fund_party_pct.label: Party-committee share of funds
fund_party_pct.desc: Share from party committees - parties triage toward winnable races.

fund_smalldollar_pct.label: Small-dollar donor share
fund_smalldollar_pct.desc: Share of individual money from small (<$200) donors.

fund_cash_share.label: Share of race cash on hand
fund_cash_share.desc: Candidate's cash on hand as a share of the race total (latest FEC report).

fund_spend_share.label: Share of race spending
fund_spend_share.desc: Candidate's spending to date as a share of the race total.

primary_margin.label: Own primary winning margin (pts)
primary_margin.desc: How much the candidate won their own primary by: the winner's share minus the runner-up's, in points. Blank if the primary had one candidate or no result was found.

opp_primary_margin.label: Opponent's primary winning margin (pts)
opp_primary_margin.desc: How much the main opponent (the strongest other candidate) won their primary by, in points.

primary_margin_diff.label: Primary margin vs opponent's (pts)
primary_margin_diff.desc: The candidate's primary margin minus the opponent's. Positive means this candidate had the easier primary of the two.

bio_office_level.label: Office experience level
bio_office_level.desc: Highest public office the candidate held BEFORE this election (4 = elected federal, 3 = elected statewide, 2 = state legislature, 1 = local elected, 0.75 = appointed federal post, 0.5 = appointed state or local post, 0 = none). A proxy for name recognition and donor networks. As-of-year, so the same person reads a lower level in an earlier cycle - a first-time candidate is 0 even if they later won office.

poll_avg.label: Polling average (%)
poll_avg.desc: Average of all the candidate's general-election polls this cycle.

poll_last.label: Most recent poll (%)
poll_last.desc: The candidate's share in the most recent dated poll.

poll_last30.label: Polling avg, final 30 days (%)
poll_last30.desc: Average over polls taken in the final 30 days before the election.

poll_std.label: Poll-to-poll variability
poll_std.desc: How much the candidate's poll numbers bounce around between surveys.

n_polls.label: # of polls (candidate)
n_polls.desc: How many polls include this candidate.

n_polls_over50.label: # of polls above 50%
n_polls_over50.desc: How many polls put the candidate above 50%.

frac_polls_over50.label: Share of polls above 50%
frac_polls_over50.desc: Fraction of the candidate's polls that put them above 50%.

race_total_polls.label: poll rows in race (field-summed)
race_total_polls.desc: Sum of per-candidate poll rows across the race (one survey of N candidates counts as N rows, so this exceeds the survey count shown in the table).

avg_sample.label: Avg poll sample size
avg_sample.desc: Average sample size of the candidate's polls (bigger = more precise).

min_days.label: Days since last poll
min_days.desc: Days between the candidate's latest poll and election day (staleness).

poll_lead.label: Polling lead vs best opponent (pts)
poll_lead.desc: Candidate's polling average minus the best opponent's.

poll_share.label: Share of race polling
poll_share.desc: Candidate's slice of all polling support in the race.

n_cands.label: # of candidates
n_cands.desc: Number of polled candidates in the race.

is_dem.label: Democrat
is_dem.desc: 1 if the candidate is a Democrat.

is_rep.label: Republican
is_rep.desc: 1 if the candidate is a Republican.

is_senate.label: Senate race
is_senate.desc: 1 if this is a Senate race.

is_gov.label: Governor race
is_gov.desc: 1 if this is a Governor race.

prior_margin_cand.label: Party's margin here last election (pts)
prior_margin_cand.desc: How much the candidate's party won/lost this seat by last time (redrawn districts use 2x the new map's Cook PVI instead).

is_incumbent.label: Candidate's party holds this seat
is_incumbent.desc: 1 if the candidate's PARTY currently holds this seat (party-level, not personal incumbency).

is_inc_party_race.label: Seat has a party incumbent
is_inc_party_race.desc: 1 if either candidate's party currently holds the seat.

twoparty_margin_cand.label: Two-party polled margin (pts)
twoparty_margin_cand.desc: Polled Dem-minus-Rep margin, signed toward this candidate.

abs_gap.label: Polled gap size (pts)
abs_gap.desc: Size of the polled gap between the two parties, ignoring direction.

tossup.label: Toss-up race (<3pt gap)
tossup.desc: 1 if the polled gap is under 3 points.

undecided.label: Undecided share (%)
undecided.desc: Share of voters not yet committed to any polled candidate.

gap_x_recency.label: Polling lead x recency
gap_x_recency.desc: Polling lead discounted by how stale the latest poll is - a fresh lead counts more than an old one.

natl_env_cand.label: National environment (generic ballot, pts)
natl_env_cand.desc: National generic-ballot mood (last 30 days), signed toward the candidate's party.

bias_prior_cand.label: Historical state poll bias (pts)
bias_prior_cand.desc: How much polls in this state have historically over/under-stated the candidate's party (prior cycles only).

poll_momentum.label: Polling momentum (slope of all polls)
poll_momentum.desc: Least-squares slope of ALL the candidate's dated polls - rising or falling.

n_lead_changes.label: # of lead changes over campaign
n_lead_changes.desc: How many times the race's front-runner changed during the campaign.

lead_changed.label: Lead ever changed
lead_changed.desc: 1 if the front-runner changed at least once.

avg_margin_over_time.label: Avg polled margin over campaign (pts)
avg_margin_over_time.desc: The candidate's average polled lead/deficit across the whole campaign.

margin_volatility.label: Polled-margin volatility
margin_volatility.desc: How unstable the candidate's polled margin has been.

min_margin.label: Worst polled margin (pts)
min_margin.desc: The candidate's worst polled margin at any point in the campaign.

margin_trend.label: Polled-margin trend
margin_trend.desc: Whether the candidate's polled margin is improving or worsening.

is_president_party.label: President's party
is_president_party.desc: 1 if the candidate's party holds the White House (midterms usually punish it).

poll_avg_60.label: Polling average, last 60 days
poll_avg_60.desc: The candidate's polling average over the last 60 days before the election only.

poll_lead_60.label: Polling lead, last 60 days (pts)
poll_lead_60.desc: The candidate's lead or deficit over the last 60 days of polls.

poll_std_60.label: Poll-to-poll variability, last 60 days
poll_std_60.desc: How much the candidate's polls moved over the last 60 days.

n_polls_60.label: # of polls, last 60 days
n_polls_60.desc: How many polls of the candidate ended in the last 60 days.

race_total_polls_60.label: Polls in the race, last 60 days
race_total_polls_60.desc: How many polls of this race ended in the last 60 days.

poll_avg_dpoll.label: Avg in Dem-sponsored polls (%)
poll_avg_dpoll.desc: Average share in polls sponsored by Democrats or Democratic groups.

poll_avg_rpoll.label: Avg in Rep-sponsored polls (%)
poll_avg_rpoll.desc: Average share in polls sponsored by Republicans or Republican groups.

poll_avg_npoll.label: Avg in nonpartisan polls (%)
poll_avg_npoll.desc: Average share in polls with no partisan sponsor.

poll_lead_dpoll.label: Lead in Dem-sponsored polls (pts)
poll_lead_dpoll.desc: Lead over the best opponent, Democratic-sponsored polls only.

poll_lead_rpoll.label: Lead in Rep-sponsored polls (pts)
poll_lead_rpoll.desc: Lead over the best opponent, Republican-sponsored polls only.

poll_lead_npoll.label: Lead in nonpartisan polls (pts)
poll_lead_npoll.desc: Lead over the best opponent, nonpartisan polls only.

n_polls_dpoll.label: # of Dem-sponsored polls
n_polls_dpoll.desc: How many Democratic-sponsored polls include the candidate.

n_polls_rpoll.label: # of Rep-sponsored polls
n_polls_rpoll.desc: How many Republican-sponsored polls include the candidate.

is_personal_inc.label: Candidate is the sitting officeholder
is_personal_inc.desc: 1 if this person (not just their party) holds the seat - won it in a previous election or sits there by appointment.

open_seat.label: Open seat
open_seat.desc: 1 if no candidate in the race is the sitting officeholder.

pres_lean_cand.label: State presidential lean (pts)
pres_lean_cand.desc: How much more the state voted for this candidate's party than the nation did in the last presidential election (state-level, even for House).

dist_pres_lean_cand.label: District presidential lean (pts)
dist_pres_lean_cand.desc: How much more the DISTRICT voted for this candidate's party than the nation did in the last presidential election, on this year's district lines (blank for Senate and Governor races, which use the state lean).

pollster_sd.label: Pollster disagreement (pts)
pollster_sd.desc: How much different pollsters disagree about this candidate.

n_pollsters.label: # of pollsters in race
n_pollsters.desc: How many different pollsters have surveyed the race.

midterm_pres_party.label: President's party in a midterm
midterm_pres_party.desc: 1 if the candidate is from the president's party in a midterm year.

midterm_approval_cand.label: Midterm x presidential approval
midterm_approval_cand.desc: Midterm penalty scaled by presidential approval: (approval - 50), positive for the president's party and negative for the other party, in midterm years only.

pres_approval_cand.label: Presidential approval (for the president's party)
pres_approval_cand.desc: The president's approval minus 50, counted for the president's party and against the other major party.

pres_unemp_cand.label: Unemployment change (for the president's party)
pres_unemp_cand.desc: The last year's change in unemployment, counted against the president's party when it rises.

pres_inflation_cand.label: Inflation (for the president's party)
pres_inflation_cand.desc: Inflation above 2%, counted against the president's party.

pres_sentiment_cand.label: Consumer sentiment (for the president's party)
pres_sentiment_cand.desc: Consumer sentiment against its long-run average, counted for the president's party when high.

poll_avg_rw.label: Recency-weighted polling avg (%)
poll_avg_rw.desc: Polling average where a poll's weight halves every 14 days, so recent polls count most.

poll_lead_rw.label: Recency-weighted polling lead (pts)
poll_lead_rw.desc: Recency-weighted polling lead over the best opponent.
